positions.name: AnalyticsDbMigrationDecision
positions.frame: what is the analytics database migration decision, and what justifies it?
positions.why: All five expressions describe the same single decision — moving the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB — from different angles: the plain declarative announcement (src-1) and its structured note-form restatement (src-3) state the decision itself; the raw rationale (src-2) and its note-form restatement (src-4) state the justification (10x performance, lower licensing cost); src-5 adds the timeline (Q3 2026) attached to that same decision. Read together, they form one directional account of a single decision-with-rationale-and-schedule rather than five independent claims. No tension held — the pairs restate each other rather than conflict.
